artifacts.name: base-x86
artifacts.notes: x86 Bliss OS base set (base_x86.qcow2/.kernel/.initrd.img + data-template + devkit). Carries libndk_translation so the arm-only arceus APK runs. The bootable x86 arceus offset is NOT yet baked — see the Slice C plan.

artifacts.name: offset-arceus-x86
artifacts.notes: Baked on a Windows/WHPX host 2026-08-13 from arceus-STATIC-REMOTE-v2.apk: a 747 MB thin COW overlay of x86/data-template-8g.qcow2, rebased to the bare backing name so images_dir stays relocatable. Verified booting — the arm64-only APK runs through the base's libndk_translation bridge. MUST land in images/x86 beside the template it overlays, or the qcow2 backing reference will not resolve.

artifacts.name: qemu-win
artifacts.notes: Official weilnetz w64 NSIS installer (~197 MB), served as a 302 rather than stored. omnidroid's ensure_qemu() silent-installs it with `<installer> /S /D=<dir>`. weilnetz prunes old dated builds, so re-pin this when it starts 404ing — doing it here fixes every client without a new release.

artifacts.name: omnidroid-bundle
artifacts.notes: Handoff only (not in the stable manifest; fetch by name). omnidroid working tree with WIP: recovered X86_* constants, the OMNIDROID_CONFIG_PATH fix, and bundled Windows QEMU (qemu/*.exe) + prebuilt dist/omnidroid.exe. This is the omnidroid state the Windows session needs (origin/main lacks the WIP).

artifacts.name: arceus-apk
artifacts.notes: Handoff only (fetch by name). The retargeted arm64 arceus build to bake onto the x86 base as base_x86_data_offset_arceusremote.qcow2.
